{{Quote|And Dankko Verrimuch!''"<br />&laquo;''Why, you're welcome, Fode!''&raquo;|quoteend=0|Fodesinbeed Annodue pokes fun at Verrimuch's name|<ref name="SW15" />}}
'''Dankko Verrimuch''' was an [[Anx/Legends|Anx]] [[Podracing/Legends|Podracer]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who competed in the final race of the [[Vinta Harvest Classic/Legends|Vinta Harvest Classic]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]]<ref name="SW15" /> around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars Omnibus: Emissaries and Assassins]]'' establishes that the events of [[Star Wars (1998) 15|''Star Wars'' (1998) 15]] take place approximately 32 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which corresponds to around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> Verrimuch's presence at the Classic's starting point in Malastare's [[Methane/Legends|methane]] wastes was recorded by [[Cam droid/Legends|cam droids]] and announced by race commentator [[Fodesinbeed Annodue/Legends|Fodesinbeed Annodue]], who labeled the group as experienced professionals and mocked the Anx's name for its similarity to the phrase "thank you very much."<ref name="SW15" />

A [[Color/Legends|green]]-skinned Anx, Verrimuch wore green [[Goggles/Legends|goggles]] with blue lenses, a purple [[Jacket/Legends|jacket]], and a gold-colored [[Necklace/Legends|necklace]] during the Vinta Harvest Classic's deciding race.<ref name="SW15" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dankko Verrimuch appeared in the [[Star Wars (1998) 15|fifteenth issue]] of [[Dark Horse Comics]]' [[Star Wars: Republic|''Star Wars'' series]], written by [[Timothy Truman]], penciled by [[Tom Lyle]],<ref name="SW15" /> and published on [[February 23]], [[2000]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/53910/star_wars_1998_15|text=Star Wars (1998) #15}}</ref>
